The users test now passes (`npm test`: 1 pass, 0 fail).

The migration `001_create_users.js` names the column `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`. I changed the API to use `fullname` in `createUser` and `getUser`. The API's public `fullName` field is unchanged, and I didn't touch `migrations/`.
